narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The ratio has a two, so I divide six by two. Three cups of rice and three cups of urad dal.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Equal cups of each make the ratio one to one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The rice must be twice the urad dal, so that slip is wrong.
